_comment: English labels for XDF titles used by me7_tool.py info. 'de' is the original XDF description, kept for reference. Abbreviations (SA, LR, LL, WE, FGR) are ME7/VAG German codes; they are kept as-is where the meaning is not certain.

TKATSA.en: Catalyst temperature threshold for overrun fuel cut-off

TATMSA.en: Exhaust gas temperature at which overrun cut-off is stopped

DNVSA.en: Overrun cut-off rpm increase at low vehicle speed

NLRSHB.en: Rpm threshold for switching off LR during overrun (with LL and TLLRSHB)
NLRSHB.de: Drehzahlschwelle, Abschalten LR bei Schub, in Verbindung mit LL und TLLRSHB

KFTVSA.en: Delay before overrun fuel cut-off (map: rpm x load)

TVSATM.en: Overrun cut-off lock time after end of start

RLMNSAN.en: Minimum air fill during overrun (characteristic curve)

REDMXSA.en: Maximum reduction stage for sequential overrun cut-off

TDMFBSA.en: PT1 filter time constant during overrun cut-off

NGDNSA.en: Rpm gradient when ramping down the overrun cut-off hysteresis

VSAA.en: Vehicle speed threshold for overrun rpm increase

DVSAVO.en: Speed delta to reset overrun-cut inhibit from cruise control (FGR)
DVSAVO.de: Delta Geschwindigkeit für Rücksetzen Schubabschalteverbot vom FGR

DVSAVU.en: Speed delta to set overrun-cut inhibit from cruise control (FGR)
DVSAVU.de: Delta Geschwindigkeit für Setzen Schubabschalteverbot vom FGR
